// Every agent may call Oxagen's own tools.
@id("rg_0011")
permit (
  principal,
  action in [
    Action::"recall_context",
    Action::"search_graph",
    Action::"expand_graph",
    Action::"append_record",
    Action::"open_context_pr",
    Action::"send_message",
    Action::"search_tools",
    Action::"load_tools",
    Action::"verify"
  ],
  resource
);
